name: Cedar Ridge
blurb: A glass-fronted family home set into a forested slope.
body:
A glass-fronted family home set into a forested slope.

The brief for Cedar Ridge asked for a residential project that responds to its setting in Quebec, Canada. We planned it around light, views and everyday movement, then built it with our own crews.

Materials were chosen to age well on site, and the same team stayed with the project from first sketch to handover in 2023.
